/products/emerald-polki-halo-drop-earrin.title: Emerald & Polki Halo Drop Earrings
/products/emerald-polki-halo-drop-earrin.description:

The result is a pair of vintage emerald diamond earrings that are perfect for wedding wear, festive occasions, bridal receptions and evening celebrations, these Indian bridal emerald drop earrings bring a regal finish to both traditional and contemporary ensembles.

/products/octagon-sapphire-pave-stud-ear.title: Octagon Sapphire Pave Stud Earrings
/products/octagon-sapphire-pave-stud-ear.description: Bold yet timeless, these statement stud earrings are designed to command attention. Designed for women who appreciate distinctive fine jewellery, they are a modern heirloom made to be worn, not saved.

/products/pave-diamond-band-ring.title: Pavé Diamond Band Ring

/products/pear-diamond-alternating-half-.title: Pear Diamond Alternating Half Eternity Band

/products/pave-paperclip-diamond-necklac.title: Pavé Paperclip Diamond Necklace
/products/pave-paperclip-diamond-necklac.description: Clean lines meet everyday sparkle in this modern Diamond Paperclip Necklace, where elongated open links are finished with fine pavé diamonds for a subtle play of light. The structured links give the necklace a contemporary, slightly architectural feel, while the delicate diamond detailing keeps it feminine and refined. Inspired by the classic gold link chain diamond necklace, this design sits beautifully at the collarbone and works just as well worn alone as it does layered with finer chains. The pavé diamond link necklace can also be styled as a sleek diamond paperclip choker, bringing a little more definition to the neckline. With its combination of open links and diamond-set sections, it has the look of a modern floating bezel diamond link necklace while retaining the flexibility and ease of a classic chain. The design is crafted in lab diamonds, making it an effortless choice for everyday luxury, evening styling, or a polished layered look.

/products/pear-cut-double-halo-engagemen.title: Pear-Cut Double Halo Engagement Ring
/products/pear-cut-double-halo-engagemen.description:

/products/scattered-pear-diamond-pendant.title: Scattered Pear Diamond Pendant

Set with IGI Certified lab grown diamonds in BIS hallmarked rose gold, it is the kind of necklace built for daily wear - easy to layer with other pieces or worn alone for a subtle, everyday luxury that never feels overstated.

/products/multi-shape-diamond-necklace.title: Multi-Shape Diamond Necklace
/products/multi-shape-diamond-necklace.description: Designed to bring together different shapes in perfect balance, this Multi Diamond Necklace is a modern take on the classic tennis necklace. From the centre to the sides, the pear and marquise diamond arrangement creates an elegant fancy shape diamond tennis necklace that can be styled as a refined choker or worn slightly lower on the neckline. The mix of cuts makes it a distinctive multi-shape diamond tennis necklace, crafted entirely with lab-grown diamonds for a contemporary take on classic diamond jewellery. Elegant enough for occasion dressing yet versatile enough to become a signature piece, this necklace is made for those who love classic diamond jewellery with a more individual, contemporary character.

/products/moval-solitaire-ring.title: Moval Solitaire Ring

/products/gulf-of-pearls-eau-de-parfum-o.description:
Gulf of Pearls opens with rose, saffron, and a hint of citrus - warm and spiced, not heavy. The heart is oud and jasmine, smooth rather than sharp. It dries down to amber, white musk, sandalwood, and patchouli - a base that's rich but wearable, and lasts well through the day.

A well-rounded oud fragrance for anyone who wants depth without going overboard. Works for evenings, cooler days, and occasions that call for something a little more considered.

100 ML · Eau de Parfum · Made in India

/products/kohinoor-amber-eau-de-parfum.title: Kohinoor Amber Eau De Parfum
/products/kohinoor-amber-eau-de-parfum.description:

Sage and lavender come through in the heart, adding a calm, herbal quality that balances the sweetness. It finishes with chestnut and vanilla - soft, warm, and comfortable on skin.

A warm fragrance that isn't loud about it. Good for cooler evenings, relaxed settings, and gifting to someone whose taste you know well - or don't know at all.

100 ML · Eau de Parfum · Made in India

/products/kailasa-breeze-eau-de-parfum.title: Kailasa Breeze Eau De Parfum
/products/kailasa-breeze-eau-de-parfum.description:
Kailasa Breeze opens with sea notes, grapefruit, and mandarin orange - clean and fresh, with good lift. Bayleaf and jasmine sit at the heart, adding a natural, slightly herbal quality. It settles into guaiac wood, oakmoss, and patchouli - earthy and warm, balancing out the freshness up top.

An easy, versatile fragrance. Works well for daily wear, travel, and warmer weather. A good starting point for anyone new to the Xazina collection.

100 ML · Eau de Parfum · Made in India

/products/kashmir-sapphire-eau-de-parfum.title: Kashmir Sapphire Eau De Parfum
/products/kashmir-sapphire-eau-de-parfum.description:
Kashmir Sapphire starts clean - grapefruit, mint, and pink pepper give it a bright, slightly spiced opening. Ginger and nutmeg come through in the middle, adding warmth without weight. The base is vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, and patchouli - woody, grounded, and long-lasting.

A straightforward, confident fragrance that wears well from morning through evening. Good for daily use and easy to wear in most settings.

100 ML · Eau de Parfum · Made in India

/products/mandarin-leather-eau-de-parfum.title: Mandarin Leather Eau De Parfum
/products/mandarin-leather-eau-de-parfum.description:
Mandarin Leather opens with apple, plum, lemon, bergamot, and oakmoss - fruity and fresh with an earthy edge. Ginger, mahogany, and carnation carry the heart, giving it a warm, slightly woody character. The base is vanilla, sandalwood, cedar, and olive tree - smooth and unhurried.

A fragrance with good contrast - bright at first, warm at the finish. Works well for those who want something a little different from the usual citrus or woody categories.

100 ML · Eau de Parfum · Made in India

  • Kailasa Breeze - Sea notes, jasmine, guaiac wood. Clean and fresh.
  • Kohinoor Amber - Mandarin, lavender, vanilla. Soft and warm.

blocks.title: FAQs
blocks.html:
FAQs

All Day, Everyday – Xazina

Everyday Diamond Jewellery You Can Wear Daily Without Worry

You don’t need to save diamonds for special occasions anymore. The shift is clear. Modern jewellery is all about pieces you can wear every day without overthinking comfort, safety, or styling. That’s exactly where everyday diamond jewellery fits in. It’s minimal, practical, and still gives you that polished, put-together look without trying too hard.

From a simple everyday diamond necklace to lightweight everyday diamond rings, the idea is simple. You wear it once, and it becomes part of your routine. No constant removing, no extra care stress, just effortless style that works whether you’re at work, running errands, or stepping out casually.

And if you’re worried about accessibility or price, lab-grown options have changed the game. Pieces like a lab grown diamond necklace give you the same elegance without making it feel like a big financial decision every time you want something new.

Why Everyday Diamond Jewellery Is Worth It

Durability That Matches Your Lifestyle

Let’s address the biggest concern first. Can diamonds actually handle daily wear? Yes, they can. Diamonds are one of the hardest natural materials, which makes them ideal for regular use. The key is choosing the right design.

For example, a diamond ring for everyday use should have a secure setting that protects the stone from impact. The same goes for bracelets and earrings. A well-crafted everyday diamond bracelet or studs designed for daily wear won’t just survive your routine, they’ll stay looking sharp for years.

This is where smart buying matters. Choosing pieces like a lab grown tennis bracelet ensures you get durability along with a clean, wearable design that doesn’t feel bulky or risky for everyday use.

Minimal Design That Actually Works Daily

Heavy, flashy jewellery looks great in photos, but it’s not practical for daily life. Everyday diamond jewellery focuses on simplicity. Clean lines, smaller stones, and lightweight settings make all the difference.

Think about diamond earrings for everyday wear. You want something that doesn’t pull on your ears or clash with your outfit. A subtle stud or a solitaire earring with diamond jewellery design works because it blends into your look instead of overpowering it.

The same logic applies to necklaces and rings. A thin chain with a small diamond or a sleek band ring becomes something you don’t even think about taking off. That’s the whole point. It should feel natural, not like an accessory you have to manage.

Investment Value Without Overcomplication

Here’s where most people overthink. They treat diamond jewellery like a one-time big purchase. But everyday jewellery flips that idea. Instead of buying one heavy piece, you build a collection of wearable items that actually get used.

Lab-grown diamonds make this even more practical. You can explore options like Lab Grown Diamond Rings Online without stretching your budget, and still get the same visual appeal and quality.

If you prefer something more classic, solitaire diamond jewellery is always a safe choice. It holds timeless value and works across outfits, which means you’re not buying something that sits in a box most of the time.

And when it comes to earrings, having at least one reliable pair of diamond earrings for everyday wear is non-negotiable. It’s one of those pieces you’ll reach for daily without even thinking.

The Real Advantage: Effortless Consistency

The biggest benefit of everyday diamond jewellery isn’t just durability or design. It’s consistency. You don’t have to rethink your look every day. You already have pieces that work.

An everyday diamond necklace, a subtle ring, and a pair of earrings can carry your entire style without needing constant upgrades. That’s what makes it worth it. It simplifies your routine while still keeping your overall look refined.

If your jewellery isn’t getting worn regularly, it’s not an investment, it’s just storage. Everyday diamond jewellery fixes that by making sure what you buy actually becomes part of your life.

Best Types of Everyday Diamond Jewellery

Everyday Diamond Necklace

If you’re starting your daily jewellery stack, this is the first piece to get right. An everyday diamond necklace should be lightweight, subtle, and easy to layer or wear solo. You don’t want something that feels heavy on your neck or clashes with different outfits. A simple pendant or a fine chain with a small diamond works best because it blends into your daily style without demanding attention.

If you want a smarter buy, go for a lab grown diamond necklace. You get the same clean look, but with more flexibility to explore designs without overspending.

Everyday Diamond Rings

Rings are tricky. They go through the most wear and tear, so design matters more than people think. Everyday diamond rings should have secure settings and a comfortable band that doesn’t get in your way while working, typing, or doing daily tasks.

Avoid oversized designs if you actually plan to wear them daily. A sleek band or a low-profile setting works better in real life. You can explore Lab Grown Diamond Rings Online to find options that balance durability with everyday wearability without compromising on style.

Everyday Diamond Bracelet

Bracelets for daily wear need to strike a balance between flexibility and strength. Too delicate, and you’ll be constantly worried. Too heavy, and it becomes uncomfortable fast. An everyday diamond bracelet should sit naturally on your wrist and move with you.

Tennis bracelets are a strong choice here because they’re structured yet comfortable. A lab grown tennis bracelet gives you that refined look while still being practical enough for regular use.

Diamond Earrings for Everyday Wear

Earrings are probably the easiest everyday diamond piece, but that doesn’t mean you should pick randomly. The best diamond earrings for everyday wear are lightweight, secure, and versatile enough to match everything.

Studs are the safest option. They don’t interfere with your routine, and they work across casual and formal settings. If you’re building a reliable daily set, start with classic diamond earrings for everyday wear that you won’t feel the need to remove constantly.

How to Choose the Right Everyday Diamond Piece

Choose Based on Your Lifestyle

Be honest about your routine. If you’re active, always on the move, or working with your hands, go for low-maintenance designs. Rings with secure settings, smaller stones, and sturdy bands make more sense than delicate or raised designs. Your jewellery should fit your life, not the other way around.

Office vs Casual Wear

Your everyday jewellery should work in both settings without needing a swap. Clean, minimal pieces transition better. A subtle everyday diamond necklace or small stud earrings can move from office meetings to casual outings without looking out of place.

If a piece only works for one type of setting, it’s not really “everyday” jewellery. Keep that in mind before buying.

Focus on Size and Comfort

This is where most people mess up. Bigger doesn’t mean better for daily wear. If a ring feels bulky or a bracelet keeps getting in the way, you’ll stop wearing it. Simple.

Comfort should be your priority. Lightweight designs, smooth edges, and balanced sizing ensure that your jewellery stays on you throughout the day without irritation or inconvenience.

FAQs

What is an Asscher cut diamond?

A square step cut with trimmed corners, a high crown and a large table. It was created by the Asscher family of Amsterdam in 1902.

How is an Asscher cut different from an emerald cut?

An Asscher cut is square with a deeper crown, which adds depth. An emerald cut is rectangular and longer.

Does an Asscher cut need a high clarity grade?

Yes. Step cuts show inclusions more than brilliant cuts, so a high clarity matters. Every Xazina diamond is VVS clarity and EF colour.

Are Xazina's Asscher diamonds lab-grown and certified?

Yes. Every Asscher diamond we set is lab-grown by the CVD method, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified, in hallmarked gold. Browse the pieces above, or customise your own.

What is a baguette cut diamond?

blocks.title: FAQ
blocks.html:
FAQ

Are lab grown diamonds are real diamonds?

Lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds with same carbon structure and chemical composition. A 'Lab Diamond' is exactly like a Natural Diamond, except instead of mining it from the Earth, they are grown in a lab.

They sparkle the same, have the same types of colour and clarity, and can come in the same sizes and shapes. In fact, they offer excellent value and are more affordable than natural ones of comparable quality and size.

Why choose lab grown diamonds?

Two important reasons to choose a lab diamond are origin & value. Rest assured that your diamond did not result in the funding of conflict in a war-torn country, nor did it require leaving a mile-wide hole in the ground. Also objectively, diamonds grown above the Earth are more pure than "dirt diamonds", blasted out of the Earth with dynamite and diesel. Compared to diamonds grown in the chaos under the Earth, diamonds grown by mankind have fewer defects and less strain in the crystal structure.

Quite simply, the more pure the diamond, the better, brighter, and whiter the gemstone.

Most of Xazina's white lab diamonds receive the highest purity rating of Type IIa whereas less than 2% of mined diamonds receive the coveted IIa purity rating.

Is a diamond bolo tie suitable for everyday wear?

Yes - the braided cord is fully adjustable, sliding to sit correctly across different collar heights and shirt styles, from a classic bandhgala to an open-collar shirt.

blocks.title: FAQs
blocks.html:
FAQs

What is a cushion cut diamond?

A square or slightly rectangular cut with rounded corners and large facets, like a pillow. It has a soft, romantic look.

Why choose a cushion cut?

The rounded corners are comfortable to wear and less likely to chip, and the stone has a soft, glowing sparkle that suits vintage and modern settings.

How is a cushion cut different from a round diamond?

A round diamond gives crisp, bright sparkle. A cushion cut gives a softer glow with more visible facets.

Are Xazina's cushion cut diamonds lab-grown and certified?

Yes. Every cushion cut diamond we set is lab-grown by the CVD method, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified, in hallmarked gold. Browse the pieces above, or customise your own.

Our lab grown diamond stud earrings offer a refined aesthetic that is subtle enough for the office yet radiant enough for a formal dinner, making them the gold standard for diamond jewellery lovers.

To ensure your investment stays exactly where it belongs, Xazina offers secure Butterfly backs and precision Screw backs. These settings are designed to provide a comfortable, "set-and-forget" fit, so you can go about your day with total confidence.
  • The Xazina Edge: Why settle for less when you can have it all? Our lab-grown stones offer 100% diamond brilliance with the exact same chemical and physical properties as earth-mined stones. By choosing Xazina, you enjoy the luxury of a premium lab grown diamond solitaire without the heavy "mined diamond" price tag or the environmental impact.

The true beauty of solitaire earrings lies in their incredible versatility and their ability to "play well with others." Because the design is so focused and pure, it acts as a perfect foundation for any jewelry stack. Whether you are aiming for a minimalist aesthetic or a more layered, maximalist look, our studs integrate seamlessly into your lifestyle.

  • The Power Couple: Create a sophisticated silhouette by matching your earrings with a delicate lab grown diamond necklace. This pairing draws light toward the face and adds a touch of effortless grace to a crisp white shirt or a cocktail dress.
  • The Full Sparkle: If you are heading from the boardroom to a high-profile event, elevate your ensemble by adding a lab grown tennis bracelet. The continuous line of light on your wrist perfectly balances the singular brilliance of your earrings.
  • Cohesive Brilliance: Complete your jewelry story by choosing to buy Lab Grown Diamond Rings Online. Coordination between your rings and earrings creates a polished, high-end look that signals a commitment to sustainable luxury.

Whether you’re flowing through a vinyasa in the yoga studio or leading a meeting, Xazina’s diamond jewellery remains a constant symbol of elegance that never feels out of place.

blocks.title: FAQs
blocks.html:
FAQs

What is an emerald cut diamond?

A rectangular step cut with trimmed corners and long, parallel facets that create a hall-of-mirrors effect. The cut was first developed for emeralds.

Do emerald cut diamonds show inclusions?

Its large open surface shows clarity and colour more than a brilliant cut does, so a high grade matters. Every Xazina diamond is VVS clarity and EF colour.

Does an emerald cut look bigger?

Its long, wide surface looks larger than a round diamond of the same weight, with a calm, understated flash instead of sparkle.

Are Xazina's emerald cut diamonds lab-grown and certified?

Yes. Every emerald cut diamond we set is lab-grown by the CVD method, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified, in hallmarked gold. Browse the pieces above, or customise your own.

blocks.title: legacy in bloom
blocks.html:
legacy in bloom

The art on every Xazina perfume box tells a story. Here's what it means.

blocks.title: Digital Art by Shivangi Gupta
blocks.html:
Digital Art by Shivangi Gupta

@_ecstaticart_

Xazina began with jewellery - with the belief that what you wear should mean something.
Not just how it looks, but what it carries. The fragrance line was born in May - the brand's birth month - inspired by the founder's mother,
a woman who believes that luxury should be intimate, intentional, and timeless.

To mark this new chapter, Legacy in Bloom was created - a four-part digital illustration that traces Xazina's journey from fine jewellery to fine fragrance.

Each frame lives on the packaging of every perfume in the collection.

blocks.title: Frame I: The Treasure
blocks.html: Frame I: The Treasure

The story begins where the name begins. Xazina means treasure - and here,
a single hand reaches into a chest overflowing with heirloom jewels, each one caught in a shaft of gold light.

It is not just an image of wealth. It is an image of inheritance. Of reaching back into something that came before you,
and choosing to carry it forward. Every great thing starts with someone deciding that what they have is worth keeping - and worth giving.

blocks.title: Frame II: The Scent
blocks.html: Frame II: The Scent

The second frame steps into something softer. White hawthorn flowers - the birth bloom of May - surround the scene.
A Xazina bottle sits at the centre, quiet and unhurried, as if it has always belonged there.

Five gemstones are placed deliberately in the composition, one for each fragrance in the debut collection. This frame isn't an announcement.
It's an arrival. The moment a brand that was born in one language finds a new way to speak.

blocks.title: Frame III: The Connection
blocks.html: Frame III: The Connection

This is the frame that stays with you.

Inspired by Michelangelo's Creation of Adam - but reimagined. Not between God and man, but between woman and man.
Two hands reaching toward each other across open sky, a breath of space between their fingertips.
A red string of fate winds between them, the ancient symbol of bonds that were always meant to be.
Diamonds catch the light on their hands - not as decoration, but as meaning. For the promises made. The milestones marked.
The relationships that become part of who you are.

The gap between their fingers is not absence. It is anticipation.

blocks.title: Frame IV: The Present
blocks.html: Frame IV: The Present

The final frame lands in the now.

A modern couple stands together, choosing jewellery - not because they have to, but because they want to share in something beautiful.
Across their backs, the word Xazina rests like a quiet seal of identity. It is a brand that does not shout. It simply becomes part of the story you are already living.

Legacy doesn't end. It just finds new people to belong to.

blocks.title: FAQs
blocks.html:
FAQs

What kind of perfumes does Xazina offer?

Xazina's debut fragrance collection includes five Eau de Parfums - Gulf of Pearls (Floral Oud), Kashmir Sapphire (Aromatic Woody), Mandarin Leather (Citrus Leather), Kailasa Breeze (Aquatic Woody), and Kohinoor Amber (Warm Amber). Each fragrance is named after a gem and available individually in 100ml bottles, or together in the Traveller Set - five 8ml minis in a signature gift box.

Are Xazina perfumes suitable for both men and women?

Yes - all five fragrances in the Xazina collection are unisex. Whether you lean towards fresh and woody or rich and warm, there is a scent in the collection that works regardless of gender.

Which Xazina perfume makes the best gift?

Any bottle makes a ready gift given the packaging. If you're unsure of the recipient's preferences, the Traveller Perfume Set is the safest choice - it includes all five fragrances in 8ml minis so they can discover their own favourite.

Do Xazina perfumes ship internationally?

Yes. Xazina ships pan-India and worldwide. Standard delivery within India takes 5–7 business days. International delivery takes 20–30 business days, subject to customs clearance. Shipping charges are calculated at checkout.

What does 'Xazina' mean?

Xazina means treasure. The name reflects the brand's identity - born from a legacy of luxury jewellery, every product Xazina creates is crafted to feel rare, intentional, and worth keeping. The fragrance collection carries that same philosophy: each bottle is named after a gem, and designed to be worn like one.

FAQs

What is a heart shaped diamond?

A brilliant cut with two rounded lobes and a point at the base. It is the shape most closely linked with romance.

What size works best for a heart shaped diamond?

The cleft and lobes show best on larger stones. A very small heart can look like a pear, so look for a well-cut, symmetrical stone.

How should a heart shaped diamond be set?

The point is the most delicate part, so it is protected with a V-shaped prong. Heart diamonds work well in pendants, rings and studs.

Are Xazina's heart shaped diamonds lab-grown and certified?

Yes. Every heart shaped diamond we set is lab-grown by the CVD method, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified, in hallmarked gold. Browse the pieces above, or customise your own.

blocks.title: FAQ
blocks.html:
FAQ

Are lab grown diamonds are real diamonds?

Lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds with same carbon structure and chemical composition. A 'Lab Diamond' is exactly like a Natural Diamond, except instead of mining it from the Earth, they are grown in a lab.

They sparkle the same, have the same types of colour and clarity, and can come in the same sizes and shapes. In fact, they offer excellent value and are more affordable than natural ones of comparable quality and size.

Why choose lab grown diamonds?

Two important reasons to choose a lab diamond are origin & value. Rest assured that your diamond did not result in the funding of conflict in a war-torn country, nor did it require leaving a mile-wide hole in the ground. Also objectively, diamonds grown above the Earth are more pure than "dirt diamonds", blasted out of the Earth with dynamite and diesel. Compared to diamonds grown in the chaos under the Earth, diamonds grown by mankind have fewer defects and less strain in the crystal structure.

Quite simply, the more pure the diamond, the better, brighter, and whiter the gemstone.

Most of Xazina's white lab diamonds receive the highest purity rating of Type IIa whereas less than 2% of mined diamonds receive the coveted IIa purity rating.

FAQs

What is a marquise cut diamond?

An elongated, boat-shaped cut with two pointed ends. It is a classic shape with a distinctive, graceful outline.

Does a marquise diamond look bigger?

Yes. It covers more of the finger than most shapes of the same carat, and it makes fingers look longer.

How do I protect the points of a marquise diamond?

The two points are the most delicate parts. A setting with prongs or a bezel over each point keeps them safe for everyday wear.

Are Xazina's marquise diamonds lab-grown and certified?

Yes. Every marquise diamond we set is lab-grown by the CVD method, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified, in hallmarked gold. Browse the pieces above, or customise your own.

Are lab grown diamonds are real diamonds?

Lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds with same carbon structure and chemical composition. A 'Lab Diamond' is exactly like a Natural Diamond, except instead of mining it from the Earth, they are grown in a lab.

They sparkle the same, have the same types of colour and clarity, and can come in the same sizes and shapes. In fact, they offer excellent value and are more affordable than natural ones of comparable quality and size.

Why choose lab grown diamonds?

Two important reasons to choose a lab diamond are origin & value. Rest assured that your diamond did not result in the funding of conflict in a war-torn country, nor did it require leaving a mile-wide hole in the ground. Also objectively, diamonds grown above the Earth are more pure than "dirt diamonds", blasted out of the Earth with dynamite and diesel. Compared to diamonds grown in the chaos under the Earth, diamonds grown by mankind have fewer defects and less strain in the crystal structure.

Quite simply, the more pure the diamond, the better, brighter, and whiter the gemstone.

Most of Xazina's white lab diamonds receive the highest purity rating of Type IIa whereas less than 2% of mined diamonds receive the coveted IIa purity rating.

blocks.title: FAQ

FAQ

Coloured Lab Grown Diamonds: Common Questions

What is a fancy coloured diamond?

A fancy coloured diamond is a diamond with a natural-looking body colour, such as pink, blue, yellow or red, instead of the usual white or colourless. The more saturated and even the colour, the more distinctive the stone. Rare Hues brings these colours together in rings and jewellery you can wear every day.

Are coloured lab-grown diamonds real diamonds?

Yes. A lab-grown diamond is real diamond, with the same carbon structure, hardness and brilliance as a mined one. The difference is that it is grown in a controlled environment instead of being dug out of the earth. This is especially useful for coloured diamonds, which are extremely rare and costly when mined.

Are the stones certified?

Yes. Every coloured diamond at Xazina is IGI certified. The certificate records the stone’s cut, carat weight, clarity and colour, so you can buy with confidence.

Which colours do you offer?

Rare Hues includes pink, yellow, blue and red diamonds. The range differs by piece, and you can use our custom jewellery service if you have a particular shade or cut in mind.

Will the colour fade over time?

No. The colour of a lab-grown diamond is part of the stone itself and doesn’t fade, wear off or need re-colouring. To keep it brilliant, clean the piece gently with warm water and mild soap, and store it separately from other jewellery.

What metals are the pieces set in?

Rare Hues pieces are crafted in 14KT and 18KT gold, in white, yellow or rose, chosen to complement the colour of the stone.

FAQ

Coloured Lab Grown Diamonds: Common Questions

What is a fancy coloured diamond?

A fancy coloured diamond is a diamond with a natural-looking body colour, such as pink, blue, yellow or red, instead of the usual white or colourless. The more saturated and even the colour, the more distinctive the stone. Rare Hues brings these colours together in rings and jewellery you can wear every day.

Are coloured lab-grown diamonds real diamonds?

Yes. A lab-grown diamond is real diamond, with the same carbon structure, hardness and brilliance as a mined one. The difference is that it is grown in a controlled environment instead of being dug out of the earth. This is especially useful for coloured diamonds, which are extremely rare and costly when mined.

Are the stones certified?

Yes. Every coloured diamond at Xazina is IGI certified. The certificate records the stone’s cut, carat weight, clarity and colour, so you can buy with confidence.

Which colours do you offer?

Rare Hues includes pink, yellow, blue and red diamonds. The range differs by piece, and you can use our custom jewellery service if you have a particular shade or cut in mind.

Will the colour fade over time?

No. The colour of a lab-grown diamond is part of the stone itself and doesn’t fade, wear off or need re-colouring. To keep it brilliant, clean the piece gently with warm water and mild soap, and store it separately from other jewellery.

What metals are the pieces set in?

Rare Hues pieces are crafted in 14KT and 18KT gold, in white, yellow or rose, chosen to complement the colour of the stone.

What is a round brilliant cut diamond?

The classic diamond shape, cut with about 57 facets to return as much light as possible. That is why a round diamond has more fire and sparkle than any other shape.

Why is round the most popular engagement ring shape?

Its symmetry gives the strongest sparkle, it hides small inclusions well, and it suits every setting, from a solitaire to a halo or three-stone ring.

Does a round diamond look bigger than other shapes?

Round diamonds look compact for their weight. Elongated shapes such as oval, pear and marquise usually show a larger surface at the same carat, so choose round for sparkle rather than size.

Are Xazina's round diamonds lab-grown and certified?

Yes. Every round diamond we set is lab-grown by the CVD method, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified, in hallmarked gold. Browse the pieces above, or customise your own.

blocks.title: FAQ
blocks.html:
FAQ

What is a paperclip chain?

A paperclip chain is made of long, oval links joined one after another, named after the shape of the office paperclip. The elongated links give it a clean, modern line that looks sleek on its own and layers easily with other chains.

What are Xazina's paperclip pieces made of?

Our paperclip jewellery is crafted in BIS hallmarked gold, with IGI-certified lab-grown diamonds set in the pieces that carry stones. Read how hallmarking works.

Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds?

Yes. Lab-grown diamonds have the same carbon crystal structure, hardness and brilliance as mined diamonds. The only difference is that they are grown in a lab instead of being mined. Ours are IGI certified, and the report states that the diamond is laboratory grown. Learn more about Xazina's lab grown diamonds.

How do I style paperclip jewellery?

Wear a paperclip chain on its own for a clean everyday look, or layer it with a finer chain or a pendant. A paperclip bracelet pairs well with a tennis bracelet, and hoops or studs keep the rest of the look minimal.

Can I customise a paperclip design?

Yes. Share your idea with us and we'll take it through concept, CAD design and a 3D prototype before it is crafted. Visit The Custom Studio or book an appointment to start.

Do you offer exchange or buyback on paperclip jewellery?

Every Xazina piece is covered by our lifetime buyback and exchange promise. The full terms are on our Buyback and Upgrade page.

blocks.title: The Design Story

The Design Story

Designed by Parth Gupta - founder of Xazina, and the diamond dude.

blocks.title: Chapter I: THE IDEA CAME FIRST
blocks.html: Chapter I: THE IDEA CAME FIRST

The True Imperfections did not begin with a stone. It began with a question - what if a piece of jewellery refused to be flawless?
What if the cracks, the asymmetry, the rawness were not things to hide, but the very point?

The concept came first. The diamond was sourced to match it.

blocks.title: Chapter II: Rooted in the Banyan
blocks.html: Chapter II: Rooted in the Banyan

India's national tree is not elegant in the conventional sense. The banyan sprawls.
Its roots drop from its own branches. It grows into itself, around itself, despite itself - and it becomes something ancient and irreplaceable.

Parth designed the necklace around this truth.

The vines of the banyan tree wrap across the entire piece - alive, unruly, reaching.
At the bottom, the gold breaks apart in fragments, like earth cracked open by roots. At the top, the vines climb and hold.
And at the centre, catching all the light - the diamond.

Not placed despite the imperfections. Placed because of them.

blocks.title: Chapter III: 486 Reasons to be Different
blocks.html: Chapter III: 486 Reasons to be Different

Every diamond on this necklace was chosen to be different.
All 486 of them are round - and none of them are the same colour grade. D, E, F, G, H -
every variation of white, every whisper of warmth - deliberately mixed across the piece.

This is not a mistake in the making. This is the making.

The differences between the stones enhance the concept they were placed to serve: that imperfection, when embraced, becomes character.

blocks.title: Chapter IV: The Heart at the Centre
blocks.html: Chapter IV: The Heart at the Centre

The hero stone is a 20 carat pink-brown heart - lab grown, rare in its colour, and unhurried in the way it holds light.
Pink for warmth. Brown for the earth.
Heart-shaped for everything that goes unsaid.

It sits at the centre of the piece not as an afterthought, but as the reason the whole piece exists.
Everything - the gold, the vines, the broken fragments - exists to hold this stone in place.

blocks.title: words from the designer

words from the designer

“India has always made the world’s most extraordinary jewellery. What we’ve lacked is the confidence to say so on a global stage. The True Imperfections is our answer to that - a piece that is deeply, unapologetically Indian in its inspiration, and completely world-class in its execution.

Lab-grown diamonds allow us to dream bigger, to set 20ct pink-brown heart shaped diamond into a single necklace without compromise.

Cannes felt like the right place to introduce that idea to the world.”

FAQ

What is The True Imperfections necklace by Xazina?

The True Imperfections is a one-of-a-kind statement necklace by Xazina, crafted in 107 grams of 9kt rose gold with 35 carats of lab-grown diamonds. At its centre sits a 20-carat pink-brown heart-shaped lab-grown diamond, entrapped within handcrafted gold vines inspired by India's national tree - the banyan tree. The piece made its world debut at the Cannes Film Festival 2026.

Which Indian lab diamond jewellery brand went to Cannes 2026?

Xazina, a lab-grown diamond jewellery brand based in Defence Colony, New Delhi, became India's first lab-grown diamond jewellery brand to debut at the Cannes Film Festival in 2026. The brand was represented through its hero piece, The True Imperfections necklace, worn by actor and content creator Vishal Pandey on the red carpet.

What jewellery did Vishal Pandey wear at Cannes 2026?

Vishal Pandey wore Xazina at the Cannes Film Festival 2026, anchored by the hero necklace The True Imperfections - featuring a 20-carat pink-brown heart-shaped lab-grown diamond set in 9kt rose gold, inspired by the banyan tree. He also wore additional pieces from Xazina including a chain, rings, and a brooch.

What makes lab-grown diamonds different from natural diamonds?

Lab-grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds - the only difference is their origin. They are created in controlled environments rather than extracted from the earth, making them a more ethical and sustainable choice without compromising on brilliance, hardness, or beauty. All diamonds in Xazina pieces, including The True Imperfections, are lab-grown and certified.

Can I buy or inquire about The True Imperfections by Xazina?

Yes. The True Imperfections is a bespoke, one-of-a-kind piece. To inquire about availability, pricing, or a custom commission inspired by the design, you can reach out to Xazina directly. Xazina also offers fully customised lab-grown diamond jewellery for those looking for something made entirely their own.

blocks.title: FAQ
blocks.html:
FAQ

Are lab grown diamonds are real diamonds?

Lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds with same carbon structure and chemical composition. A 'Lab Diamond' is exactly like a Natural Diamond, except instead of mining it from the Earth, they are grown in a lab.

They sparkle the same, have the same types of colour and clarity, and can come in the same sizes and shapes. In fact, they offer excellent value and are more affordable than natural ones of comparable quality and size.

Why choose lab grown diamonds?

Two important reasons to choose a lab diamond are origin & value. Rest assured that your diamond did not result in the funding of conflict in a war-torn country, nor did it require leaving a mile-wide hole in the ground. Also objectively, diamonds grown above the Earth are more pure than "dirt diamonds", blasted out of the Earth with dynamite and diesel. Compared to diamonds grown in the chaos under the Earth, diamonds grown by mankind have fewer defects and less strain in the crystal structure.

Quite simply, the more pure the diamond, the better, brighter, and whiter the gemstone.

Most of Xazina's white lab diamonds receive the highest purity rating of Type IIa whereas less than 2% of mined diamonds receive the coveted IIa purity rating.

blocks.title: Creation
blocks.html:
Creation

Are Xazina's lab grown diamonds real diamonds?

Yes. Lab grown diamonds have the exact same chemical composition, crystal structure, and optical properties as mined diamonds - they're grown, not synthetic imitations like cubic zirconia or moissanite. The only difference is origin: one forms underground over billions of years, the other is grown above ground in weeks. Even trained gemmologists need specialised equipment to tell them apart.

How are lab grown diamonds made?

Lab grown diamonds are created using Chemical Vapour Deposition (CVD), a process that replicates the natural conditions under which diamonds form - layer by layer, inside a controlled chamber. The result is a diamond identical in chemical structure, brilliance, and hardness to a mined one.

Why are lab grown diamonds more affordable than mined diamonds?

Lab grown diamonds skip the cost of mining, land excavation, and the artificial scarcity built into the natural diamond supply chain. You're paying for the diamond itself - not the cost of extracting it from the earth - which is why Xazina is able to offer the same quality at a more accessible price, without compromising on certification or craftsmanship.

Where is Xazina jewellery made, and who crafts it?

Every Xazina piece is handcrafted in-house by expert artisans, from setting to final polish. This hands-on process ensures each piece meets our quality standards before it reaches you.

Will a lab grown diamond look or perform differently from a mined diamond?

No. Lab grown and mined diamonds are optically and physically identical - same sparkle, same hardness, same fire and brilliance. The only way to distinguish them is through specialised lab equipment that reads their growth origin, not their appearance or quality.

Why choose lab grown diamonds over mined diamonds?

Two reasons: origin and value. Lab grown diamonds don't carry the environmental cost of mining or the risk of funding conflict - they're grown responsibly, above ground. And because they skip the cost of extraction and artificial scarcity, you get the same brilliance and quality at a more accessible price. It's the same diamond, minus the cost the earth pays for it.

What are the 4Cs of a lab grown diamond?

Lab grown diamonds are graded on the same 4Cs as mined diamonds - Cut, Colour, Clarity, and Carat Weight - by independent gemmological labs like IGI. Quality still varies across lab diamonds just as it does with mined ones, so certification matters. See our guide to Xazina's lab grown diamonds.

blocks.title: Care & Repair
blocks.html:
Care & Repair

How do I take care of my jewellery?

To keep your jewellery sparkling, clean it with warm water, mild soap, and a soft brush. Store it separately to avoid scratches, and remove it before swimming or using harsh chemicals.

Do you offer cleaning or repair services?

Yes! We offer complimentary cleaning for all Xazina pieces. For repairs, our expert team is here to help – just reach out to us.

blocks.title: Quality Assurance
blocks.html:
Quality Assurance

Are your diamonds certified?

Yes, all Xazina’s lab diamonds come with certification to guarantee their authenticity, quality, and brilliance.

Will my lab diamond look different from a mined diamond?

Not at all! Lab diamonds are identical to mined diamonds in cut, clarity, colour, and durability. Even jewellers need specialised equipment to tell them apart.

blocks.title: Sustainability
blocks.html:
Sustainability

Are lab diamonds more sustainable than mined diamonds?

Yes! Lab diamonds have a lower environmental impact, as they don’t require mining, deforestation, or excessive water use. They’re a responsible choice without compromising on luxury.

Is Xazina an ethical brand?

Absolutely! We prioritise transparency, ethical sourcing, and sustainability, ensuring every piece is made with care – for both people and the planet.

blocks.title: Orders
blocks.html:
Orders

How do I place an order?

Simply browse our collection, add your favourite pieces to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Need assistance?
Our team is always happy to help!

Can I modify or cancel my order?

We begin crafting your jewellery as soon as your order is placed. If you need to make changes, contact us within six hours, and we’ll do our best to accommodate your request.

blocks.title: Payments
blocks.html:
Payments

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept payments through Razorpay, which supports all major credit and debit cards, including Visa, MasterCard, American Express, as well as UPI transactions. All transactions are encrypted and 100% secure for a smooth shopping experience.

blocks.title: Shipping & Delivery
blocks.html:
Shipping & Delivery

Do you ship internationally?

Yes! We offer secure, insured international shipping. Shipping costs and delivery times vary based on location – just enter your details at checkout for more information.

How long does shipping take?

Each Xazina piece is handcrafted with care. Standard orders take 7–8 working days to ship, and we’ll keep you updated every step of the way.

Is my package insured?

Yes! All orders are fully insured during transit, so your jewellery is protected until it reaches you.

blocks.title: Upgrade, Returns & Buyback
blocks.html:
Upgrade, Returns & Buyback

What is your return policy?

We want you to love your Xazina piece! If it’s not quite right, you can return or exchange it within 5 days, as long as it’s unworn and in its original packaging. (Custom pieces are final sale.)

Do you offer a buyback policy?

Yes! We offer a buyback and upgrade policy if you ever wish to upgrade or trade in your Xazina jewellery. Contact us to learn more.

How do I initiate a return?

Just reach out to us, and we’ll guide you through the simple return process.

blocks.title: Buyback and Upgrade
blocks.html:
Buyback and Upgrade

Upgrade Policy

  • Xazina offers a lifetime upgrade policy, allowing you to exchange your product at any time.
  • Upon upgrade, the making charges associated with the original product will be deducted.
  • Upgrades are allowed only for new items with an invoice value greater than that of the product being upgraded.
  • The full invoice value of the original product (excluding making charges) will be deducted from the new invoice.
  • A 7-day inspection period applies to all exchanged products. If any discrepancies are found, the amount will be deducted from the upgrade value.
  • If you choose not to upgrade immediately, you may receive a voucher for the upgrade value, redeemable at a later time with no expiration.
  • The original invoice must be presented at the time of upgrade.
  • Any discount availed during the purchase of the product will be deducted from the refund amount during upgrade.

Lifetime Buy-Back Policy

  • Xazina offers a lifetime buy-back option, allowing you to sell your product back to us at any time.
  • We provide the current market rate for the gold content in the jewellery, with a 20% deduction on the market value of the diamonds. Making charges will also be deducted.
  • A 10-day inspection period is required to evaluate the product and determine the refund amount. Any discrepancies found during inspection will result in a deduction from the refund value.
  • Once the refund value is confirmed, the payment will be processed via bank transfer. No cash refunds.
  • The original invoice must be presented when opting for the buy-back policy.
  • The buy-back policy is applicable for products up to a limit of INR 5,00,000.
  • Any discount availed during the purchase of the product will be deducted from the refund amount during returns.
  • Delays and Exceptions: Delivery timelines are estimates and may be extended during holidays, festivals, peak sale periods, or unforeseen events such as weather disruptions or customs delays.
  • Order Tracking: Tracking details are shared via email or SMS upon dispatch. All shipments are insured and may require a signature upon delivery.

For any return, exchange or buy-back request, please contact our support team at sales@xazinajewels.com.

/pages/how-to-measure-your-bangle-size.title: How to Measure Your Bangle Size
/pages/how-to-measure-your-bangle-size.description: Find your perfect bangle fit. Measure the inner diameter of a bangle that already fits and match it to Xazina's size chart.

blocks.title: Check Size Guide
blocks.html:
Size Chart

How To Measure?

Check Size Guide

1. Use an existing bangle
Take a bangle that already fits you comfortably.
2. Measure the inner diameter
Place it flat on a table and measure the inside width (straight across the center) using a standard ruler or measuring tape. Note the measurement in millimeters (mm).
3. Check your size
Match your measurement to our bangle size chart to find the right fit.

/pages/how-to-measure-your-ring-size.title: How to Measure Your Ring Size
/pages/how-to-measure-your-ring-size.description: Find your perfect ring size with two easy methods  –  measure an existing ring or your finger  –  and match it to Xazina's size chart.

blocks.title: Check Size Guide
blocks.html:
Size Chart

Method 1

Method 2

Check Size Guide

Using an Existing Ring

1. Select a ring that fits your finger comfortably.
2. Measure the inner diameter of the ring in millimeters (mm).
3. Match this measurement to our ring size chart to find your size.

Measuring Your Finger

1. Take a measuring tape, string, or strip of paper.
2. Wrap it around the finger where you’ll wear the ring.
3. Mark the spot where the ends meet.
4. Lay the string or paper flat and measure the length in millimeters (mm). This is the circumference of your ring size.
5. Use the size chart to map the circumference to the corresponding diameter. This gives you your correct ring size to shop at XAZINA.

/pages/how-to-measure-your-bracelet-size.title: How to Measure Your Bracelet Size
/pages/how-to-measure-your-bracelet-size.description: Find your perfect bracelet fit. Measure your wrist with a string or tape and match it to Xazina's bracelet size chart.

blocks.title: Check Size Guide
blocks.html:
Size Chart

How To Measure?

Check Size Guide

1. Measure your wrist
Wrap a string, ribbon, or flexible measuring tape around your wrist where you normally wear a bracelet. Adjust for your preferred fit (snug or loose).
2. Mark the size
If using a string or ribbon, mark the point where the ends meet to complete the circle.
3. Measure the length
Lay the string or ribbon flat against a ruler or measuring tape and note the length in centimeters.
4. Find your size
Compare your wrist measurement to our bracelet size chart to select the perfect fit.

/pages/how-to-measure-your-oval-bracelet.title: How to Measure Your Oval Bracelet Size
/pages/how-to-measure-your-oval-bracelet.description: Find your perfect oval bracelet fit. Measure your wrist and match it to Xazina's size chart for a comfortable, secure fit every time.

blocks.title: Check Size Guide
blocks.html:
Size Chart

How To Measure?

Check Size Guide

1. Measure your Oval Bracelet
Take an oval bracelet that already fits you well and measure its inner diameter in millimeters (mm).
2. Compare with the chart
Match your measurement with our oval bracelet size chart to find the closest size.
3. Check the fit
Make sure the width of the oval bracelet sits comfortably on your wrist for a secure and natural fit.

blocks.title: FAQ
blocks.html:
FAQ

Lab-Grown Diamond Engagement Rings – Xazina

Every Xazina engagement ring is made with IGI-certified lab-grown diamonds, set in 9kt, 14kt or 18kt gold and finished by hand. Lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds with the same sparkle, hardness and chemical makeup as mined ones, grown in a lab instead of dug from the earth. Start with our lab-grown diamond solitaire rings, or choose a shape you love from the shape finder above, in round, oval, princess, emerald, pear and more.

If you want something that's yours alone, our custom jewellery service can change the stone, setting, metal or engraving, or build a ring from scratch. Once you've found the ring, our diamond eternity bands are a natural match for a wedding set, and the Wedding Edit brings together jewellery for the rest of the celebration.

Not sure where to start? Book an appointment, in-store or on a call, and we'll help you choose.

Are lab-grown diamonds real diamonds?

Yes. A lab-grown diamond has the same chemical makeup, hardness and brilliance as a mined diamond. The only difference is where it's grown. That's why you can choose a larger or higher-quality stone for your budget.

Are your diamonds certified?

Yes. Our lab-grown diamonds are IGI-certified, so the cut, colour, clarity and carat weight of your stone are recorded in writing.

Can I engrave my ring?

Yes, and engraving is free. You can add initials, a date or a short message of up to 30 characters, hidden inside or on the surface.

Can I customise a ring?

Yes. We can change the stone shape, setting, metal or size, or design a ring from scratch. Start with our custom jewellery service, or book an appointment and we'll guide you.

How long will my ring take to arrive?

Every product page shows the estimated delivery date for that ring, so you can check it before you order. Custom and engraved rings are made to order, so we recommend ordering early. If you have a proposal date in mind, book an appointment and we'll tell you what's possible.

blocks.title: Lab Grown Diamonds
blocks.html:
Lab Grown Diamonds

Lab-grown. Real diamonds.

blocks.title: What is a diamond, really?
blocks.html:
What is a diamond, really?

A diamond is carbon, arranged in a crystal structure and pressed under immense heat until it becomes the hardest natural material we know.

Whether that happens deep in the earth over billions of years or inside a controlled chamber over a few weeks, the result is the same crystal. It has the same atoms, the same hardness and the same fire.

A lab-grown diamond is not a simulant and it is not glass. It is a diamond, made above ground.

At Xazina, every stone we set is a lab-grown diamond, graded and certified so you know exactly what you are wearing.

blocks.title: Why lab-grown diamonds?
blocks.html:
Why lab-grown diamonds?

Because you know where yours came from. Every stone is traceable from the day it was grown to the day it reaches you.

Because the same budget can buy a larger, cleaner or more colourful stone, including fancy pink, blue, yellow and red diamonds that are rare and costly when mined.

And because there is no compromise on quality: they are diamonds in every way that matters.

blocks.title: The 4Cs of diamonds
blocks.html:
Know before you buy

The 4Cs of diamonds

Carat

Carat is simply the weight of a diamond, not its size. Two diamonds of the same carat can look bigger or smaller than each other depending on how they're cut. Instead of chasing a number, we help you pick a carat weight that actually looks right on your hand.

Cut

Cut is what makes a diamond sparkle. It's not about the shape (like round or oval) - it's about how well the diamond is faceted to catch and reflect light. A well-cut diamond looks brighter and more alive, even if it's smaller.

Colour

The whiter a diamond, the more it sparkles. Diamonds are graded from colourless to slightly yellow, and the closer to colourless, the more premium the stone.

Clarity

Clarity is about how clean a diamond looks inside. Most diamonds have tiny natural marks invisible to the eye - clarity grading just tells you how few and how small they are. The higher the clarity, the clearer the stone.

blocks.title: Diamond certification
blocks.html:
Diamond certification

A grading report is an independent record of a diamond. It lists the stone's carat weight, cut, colour and clarity, along with its measurements and proportions.

It is written by a gemmological laboratory with no stake in the sale, which is what makes it worth trusting.

Every Xazina diamond comes with its report, so what you read is what you receive.

blocks.title: Why IGI certification matters
blocks.html:
Why IGI certification matters

Globally recognised

IGI is one of the world's most widely trusted grading laboratories, accepted by jewellers everywhere.

Complete transparency

Every grade, measurement and detail is written down, with nothing left to guesswork.

Laser inscription

The report number is inscribed on the diamond, so the stone and its certificate always match.

blocks.title: Our approach to diamonds
blocks.html:

Every piece is backed by our exchange and lifetime buyback promise, so you can buy with confidence today and know it will hold its place tomorrow.

blocks.title: FAQs
blocks.html:
LAB DIAMONDS

FAQs

ASK US DIRECTLY

What is the difference between lab-grown and natural diamonds?

The only difference is where the diamond comes from. A lab-grown diamond is grown above ground and is fully traceable. A natural diamond is mined. The same budget usually buys a larger, cleaner or more colourful lab-grown stone, including fancy pink, blue and yellow diamonds.

How are Xazina's lab-grown diamonds made?

Our diamonds are grown by the CVD (chemical vapour deposition) method. A tiny diamond seed is placed in a chamber, and carbon atoms build up on it layer by layer into a rough crystal. The crystal is then cut and polished. Our stones are EF colour and VVS clarity.

Do lab-grown diamonds last forever and pass the diamond tester?

Yes. A lab-grown diamond is as hard as a mined one, 10 on the Mohs scale, so it resists scratching and lasts a lifetime. It also passes a standard diamond tester, because it is a diamond. Set in hallmarked gold, it is made for everyday wear and heirloom keeping. See our jewellery care guide.

Where can I buy certified lab-grown diamond jewellery in India?

You can shop Xazina online, or visit our store in Defence Colony, Delhi. Browse lab-grown diamond rings, or customise your own piece. Every piece is set in BIS hallmarked 9KT, 14KT or 18KT gold, with an IGI-certified diamond and our exchange and lifetime buyback promise.

blocks.title: Caring for your lab grown diamonds
blocks.html:
Care guide

Caring for your
lab grown diamonds

Lab grown diamonds share the exact hardness, brilliance and chemical structure of mined diamonds, so they wear beautifully every day. The little extra care they ask for is really for everything around the stone: the setting, the polish, the clasp.

blocks.title: Simple habits, lasting sparkle
blocks.html:
The do's

Simple habits, lasting sparkle

Weekly cleaning

Give your jewellery a gentle clean every week. Swirl it under running water with a soft brush to clear away dust and everyday residue.

Monthly deep clean

Once a month, soak it in warm water with a little hand soap or mild detergent for about 30 minutes, then rinse well and pat dry.

Store separately

Keep each piece apart from the others, with room to breathe. Metal rubbing against metal wears down prongs, which is how smaller stones eventually work loose.

Yearly check

Have your prongs, clasps and settings checked once a year. A quick inspection keeps your stones secure and catches small issues before they turn into repairs.

blocks.title: Jewellery goes on last and comes off first.
blocks.html:
Jewellery goes on last
and comes off first.

blocks.title: What to avoid, and why
blocks.html:
The don'ts

What to avoid, and why

Perfume and nail care

Keep away from perfume, nail polish and nail polish remover. They can dull the finish and change the colour of the jewellery over time.

Bathing and handwashing

Don't wear rings in the bath or shower, or while washing hands with soap, shampoo or conditioner. Residue gets trapped behind the stone and dulls its shine.

Lotions and creams

Keep pieces away from lotions and creams. They collect underneath the setting and slowly turn into grime.

Gym and housework

Skip the gym and the dishes. The friction and impact can loosen prongs over time.

Sleeping

Avoid wearing rings to bed. Sustained pressure while you sleep can gradually bend the band.

Hot tubs and heat

Stay out of hot tubs. Heat loosens settings and can cause a stone to come loose or fall out.

Gardening, ocean and pools

Avoid wearing jewellery for gardening or in the ocean and pools. It helps prevent both losing the piece and scratches from manual work.

Bleach and household cleaners

Keep jewellery away from bleach and harsh cleaning products. They can damage the gold and weaken the settings that hold your stones.

blocks.title: Hallmarked Gold
blocks.html:
Hallmarked Gold

Pure gold. Certified.

blocks.title: What is a gold hallmark?
blocks.html:
What is a gold hallmark?

A hallmark is a small official stamp, pressed into the gold itself, that tells you how pure it is. It is checked and applied by a hallmarking centre licensed by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), not by the jeweller who sells the piece.

It turns a promise into proof. Instead of taking anyone's word for the purity of your gold, you can read it on the jewellery.

At Xazina, every piece of lab diamond jewellery is set in hallmarked gold.

blocks.title: Why does hallmarking matter?
blocks.html:
Why does hallmarking matter?

You cannot see purity. Two pieces of gold can look identical and hold very different amounts of gold. The hallmark tells you exactly what you are getting.

It protects you. Whether you buy, exchange or upgrade, a hallmarked piece carries a verified purity, so its worth is never in doubt.

You can check it yourself. Every piece carries its own six-character HUID, which you can verify on the BIS Care app.

blocks.title: The gold we use
blocks.html:
The gold we use

9KT gold

9KT gold is 37.5% pure gold, marked 375. The hardest of the three, it is a durable and accessible choice for everyday jewellery.

14KT gold

14KT gold is 58.5% pure gold, marked 585. The added alloy makes it harder, so it stands up well to everyday wear.

18KT gold

18KT gold is 75% pure gold, marked 750. Rich in colour and warmth, it is a classic choice for fine jewellery.

Why not 24KT?

24KT is pure gold, and too soft to hold diamonds safely. Mixing it with other metals gives a ring or bracelet its strength, and the hallmark tells you exactly how much gold is in the mix.

blocks.title: How to read a hallmark
blocks.html:
How to read a hallmark

Look inside the band, or on the back or clasp of the piece. The marks are tiny, so use a loupe, or ask our team to point them out. A BIS hallmark has three parts.

The BIS logo, which shows the piece was hallmarked under Indian standards.

The purity, shown in carat and fineness, such as 18K750, 14K585 or 9K375.

The HUID, a six-character alphanumeric code that belongs to that piece alone.

To check it, open the BIS Care app and enter the HUID to see the registered details of your jewellery.

blocks.title: Our approach to gold
blocks.html:
Our approach to gold

We set every Xazina diamond in hallmarked 9KT, 14KT or 18KT gold, so the metal is as trustworthy as the stone. Alongside the IGI report on your diamond, your jewellery carries its gold purity on record.

Every piece is also backed by our exchange and lifetime buyback promise, so you can buy with confidence today and know it will hold its place tomorrow.

blocks.title: FAQs
blocks.html:
HALLMARKED GOLD

FAQs

ASK US DIRECTLY

What is hallmarked gold?

Hallmarked gold is gold that has been tested for purity and stamped with an official mark. In India the mark is applied by a BIS licensed hallmarking centre, and it shows the purity of the gold and a unique HUID for the piece. Every Xazina piece of lab diamond jewellery is set in hallmarked gold.

Is Xazina's gold jewellery hallmarked?

Yes. Every Xazina piece is set in BIS hallmarked 9KT, 14KT or 18KT gold. The lab diamonds in it are CVD-grown, EF colour, VVS clarity and IGI certified. See how we grow and grade our diamonds.

What does the BIS hallmark mean on jewellery?

The BIS hallmark is the Bureau of Indian Standards' proof of purity. It has three parts: the BIS logo, the purity in carat and fineness (such as 18K750), and a six-character HUID. Together they confirm what your gold is made of.

What is HUID and how do I check it?

HUID stands for Hallmark Unique ID. It is a six-character alphanumeric code stamped on each hallmarked piece, and no two pieces share one. To check it, open the BIS Care app and enter the HUID from your jewellery.

What is the difference between 9KT, 14KT and 18KT gold?

18KT gold is 75% pure gold, 14KT is 58.5% and 9KT is 37.5%. The higher the karat, the richer the colour. The lower the karat, the harder the gold, so 14KT and 9KT suit everyday wear well. All three are hallmarked, so you can read the exact purity on the piece. Read how to look after them in our jewellery care guide.

Where can I buy hallmarked gold lab diamond jewellery in Delhi?

You can buy hallmarked gold lab diamond jewellery at Xazina's store in Defence Colony, Delhi, or shop our range online. Visit us to see the hallmark on any piece, try on engagement rings and everyday jewellery, and get one-on-one guidance. Book an appointment before you visit.

/blogs/lab-grown-diamond-journal-by-xazi.content:
In the vast universe of jewellery, few pieces hold the universal appeal and enduring relevance of classic diamond studs. These seemingly simple earrings are, in fact, miniature marvels of brilliance and versatility, capable of elevating any look from casual to formal with effortless grace. A true jewellery wardrobe staple, their timeless design ensures they never go out of style. At Xazina, we celebrate the iconic beauty and ethical purity of lab-grown diamond studs, offering a sustainable choice that embodies ultimate elegance and everyday luxury.

The Unmatched Versatility of Diamond Studs

The power of diamond studs lies in their unparalleled versatility. Their clean, understated design makes them suitable for every occasion, age, and personal style. They seamlessly transition from a morning coffee run to a boardroom meeting, and then effortlessly into an elegant evening event. Unlike more elaborate earrings, studs don't compete with other jewellery or overwhelm an outfit; instead, they provide a perfect touch of sparkle that enhances your natural features and brings light to your face. They are the ideal "set it and forget it" accessory, offering consistent brilliance without demanding constant attention.

Key Elements of a Classic Pair

The beauty of classic diamond studs lies in the quality of their components. The most crucial element is, of course, the diamond itself. For optimal sparkle and brilliance, consider the 4Cs – Carat, Cut, Color, and Clarity – with Cut being paramount for maximizing light return. Round brilliant cuts are the most popular choice for studs due to their exceptional sparkle. The setting also plays a vital role: a four-prong or six-prong setting holds the diamond securely while allowing maximum light entry. A bezel setting offers a more modern, protected look. For metals, white gold and platinum are popular for emphasizing the diamond's colorless nature, while yellow gold can add a touch of warmth.

Styling Your Everyday Brilliance

Styling classic diamond studs is refreshingly simple. For daily wear, they are the ultimate minimalist accessory, adding sparkle without fuss. For work or professional settings, they offer a polished and sophisticated touch. When dressing for a special occasion, diamond studs can be paired with a matching diamond necklace or bracelet for a cohesive look, or they can be the sole source of sparkle to maintain an understated elegance. They also serve as the perfect foundation for building an "ear stack," complementing ear cuffs or other smaller earrings without overshadowing them. Their adaptability makes them an indispensable part of any jewellery collection.

The Xazina Promise: Timeless Beauty, Ethical Choice

Choosing lab-grown diamond studs is not just a style statement; it's a responsible one. The new policy increases import duties on several categories, including:

  • Loose polished diamonds

While the tariff hike is aimed at protecting US-based manufacturers, it impacts Indian exporters competing in the American luxury and bridal market.

a. Higher Landed Cost in the US
Products from India will be more expensive for US retailers to stock, potentially reducing orders.

b. Shift in Buying Preferences
US buyers may:

  • Source more from tariff-exempt countries

  • Negotiate harder on pricing with Indian suppliers

  • Focus on lab-grown diamonds where margins allow more flexibility

c. Pressure on Margins
Exporters may absorb part of the tariff impact to remain competitive – squeezing profitability.

🌱 3. Why Lab-Grown Diamonds Could Gain an Edge

Lab-grown diamonds – especially CVD diamonds made in India – may weather the tariff storm better due to:

  • Lower base cost compared to natural diamonds

Trending Diamond Rakhi Designs for Raksha Bandhan 2025

Raksha Bandhan 2025 is set to be a sparkling affair, with diamond Rakhi designs emerging as a prominent trend that beautifully blends tradition with modern luxury. Far from being simple threads, today's Rakhis are evolving into exquisite pieces of jewellery that brothers can cherish long after the festivities. This year, the focus is on designs that offer both sentimental value and enduring style, incorporating the timeless brilliance of diamonds in innovative ways. These trending designs reflect a desire for gifts that are meaningful, luxurious, and perfectly aligned with contemporary aesthetics.

Minimalist Diamond Rakhis

The "less is more" philosophy reigns supreme in Rakhi designs for 2025. Minimalist diamond Rakhis feature delicate chains or fine threads adorned with a single, small, yet brilliantly cut lab-grown diamond. These designs are subtle, sophisticated, and incredibly versatile, making them suitable for everyday wear. They often come in sterling silver, white gold, or rose gold settings, emphasising the diamond's natural sparkle without overt embellishment. This trend appeals to brothers who prefer understated elegance and a symbolic piece of jewellery that seamlessly integrates into their daily attire, offering a modern twist on the traditional thread.

Personalised Diamond Rakhis

Personalisation continues to be a powerful trend in gifting, and diamond Rakhi designs are no exception. For Raksha Bandhan 2025, look for Rakhis that incorporate a lab-grown diamond alongside an engraved initial, a significant date, or a custom symbol. These designs can feature the diamond as the centrepiece, with the personalised element etched onto a small metal charm attached to the Rakhi thread or band. Such bespoke pieces create a deeply intimate and unique gift, transforming the Rakhi into a cherished memento that holds profound personal meaning, truly celebrating the individuality of the sibling bond.

Convertible Diamond Rakhis

Innovation in jewellery design is leading to the popularity of convertible diamond Rakhis. These ingenious designs serve as a Rakhi for the ceremony but can later be repurposed into a wearable piece of jewellery, such as a diamond bracelet or a pendant. This versatility offers exceptional value and ensures the Rakhi’s brilliance can be enjoyed long after Raksha Bandhan. Typically, these designs feature a central lab-grown diamond element that can be detached from the thread and reattached to a chain or bracelet clasp, making it a sustainable and practical gift that maximises its longevity and style.

Modern Motif Diamond Rakhis

Moving beyond traditional religious symbols, modern motif diamond Rakhis are gaining traction. These designs incorporate lab-grown diamonds into contemporary shapes like geometric patterns, abstract forms, or universal symbols of love and protection (e.g., infinity signs, tree of life motifs). The diamonds are often pavé-set or bezel-set within these modern shapes, adding sparkle to a clean, architectural design. These Rakhis appeal to brothers with a fashion-forward sensibility, offering a stylish accessory that is both culturally relevant and aesthetically appealing, perfect for expressing a bond that is both traditional and modern.

Durable Metal Band Diamond Rakhis

For brothers seeking a more robust and permanent alternative to the traditional thread, durable metal band diamond Rakhis are a top trend. These designs feature lab-grown diamonds set into sleek bands of sterling silver, titanium, or even gold, designed to be worn as everyday bracelets. They offer superior longevity and a sophisticated masculine appeal. Some designs incorporate the appearance of a braided thread in metal, with diamond accents, cleverly blending the traditional aesthetic with durable jewellery craftsmanship. This ensures the Rakhi remains a constant, brilliant reminder of the sibling bond.

Raksha Bandhan 2025 is embracing innovation with trending diamond Rakhi designs that offer a perfect blend of tradition, luxury, and ethical responsibility. Whether you choose a minimalist, personalised, convertible, or modern motif design, selecting a lab-grown diamond Rakhi ensures a brilliant and meaningful gift for your brother. Explore Xazina's exclusive collection to find a diamond Rakhi that truly captures the essence of your unique sibling bond this festive season.

The Return of Statement Jewellery: Bold Looks for Rakhi 2025

Raksha Bandhan 2025 is signalling a vibrant shift in fashion, with the undeniable return of statement jewellery. After years of minimalist trends, there's a renewed enthusiasm for bold, eye-catching pieces that make a definitive style declaration. This festive season, celebrating sibling bonds offers the perfect opportunity to embrace dramatic designs, whether through oversized earrings, chunky necklaces, or elaborate rings. These bold looks are about expressing individuality and confidence, turning your jewellery into the undeniable star of your Rakhi ensemble, reflecting a desire to stand out and celebrate with impactful flair.

Embracing Oversized Diamond Earrings

For Rakhi 2025, oversized diamond earrings are making a grand comeback. Think chandelier earrings adorned with cascading lab-grown diamonds, or large hoops intricately set with brilliant stones. These earrings can instantly transform a simple outfit into a show-stopping look, drawing attention to your face and adding a touch of dramatic glamour. When opting for such bold earrings, it's often best to keep other jewellery minimal to let them shine. They are perfect for sisters attending festive gatherings who want to make a memorable impression with their jewellery choices, embodying confidence and a flair for the dramatic.

Choker and Collar Diamond Necklaces

Statement necklaces are reclaiming their throne, particularly choker and collar diamond necklaces. These pieces sit high on the neck, offering a powerful visual impact. Designs featuring clusters of lab-grown diamonds, intricate patterns, or bold geometric shapes set in gold or platinum are particularly popular. A diamond collar necklace can elevate a simple kurta, a plain saree, or even a contemporary gown, instantly adding a layer of sophisticated opulence. This trend encourages wearing the necklace as the sole focal point, creating a strong and luxurious silhouette that perfectly complements the festive mood of Raksha Bandhan.

Chunky Diamond Bracelets and Cuffs

The wrist gets a bold upgrade with the return of chunky diamond bracelets and cuffs. These substantial pieces are designed to be noticed, featuring wider bands, intricate detailing, and numerous lab-grown diamonds arranged in striking patterns. A single, well-chosen diamond cuff can make a powerful style statement, whether worn with traditional Indian wear or contemporary fusion outfits. These bracelets exude confidence and offer a modern interpretation of classic luxury, perfect for those who prefer to make their statement through their wristwear, symbolising a strong and enduring bond with bold elegance.

Sculptural and Cocktail Diamond Rings

For those who love to make a statement with their hands, sculptural and cocktail diamond rings are the ultimate choice. These rings go beyond simple solitaires, featuring oversized designs, unique architectural forms, or intricate settings adorned with a cluster of lab-grown diamonds. Worn on the index or middle finger, a diamond cocktail ring can become a conversation starter and a true reflection of personal style. These rings are perfect for adding a touch of drama and individuality, showcasing a flair for fashion and an appreciation for artful jewellery design that beautifully complements festive celebrations.

Strategic Layering of Bold Pieces

While the rule for statement jewellery is often "one bold piece at a time," Rakhi 2025 also embraces the art of strategic layering for a maximalist approach. This means pairing a bold necklace with simple yet impactful diamond stud earrings, or layering several chunky diamond bracelets on one wrist while keeping the neckline minimal. The key is balance and intentionality, ensuring that each piece contributes to a cohesive, luxurious, and bold overall look without appearing chaotic. This allows for a truly personalised and daring festive style, celebrating the unique sibling bond with opulent flair.

The return of statement jewellery for Rakhi 2025 offers an exciting opportunity to showcase bold and brilliant looks. By choosing impressive lab-grown diamond pieces, you can celebrate the festive season with confidence, ethical integrity, and unparalleled sparkle.
